# flask-modelkit

> Composable model mixins for Flask-SQLAlchemy: UUID keys, UTC timestamps, soft delete, safe writes from request data (create_or_abort, update), hidden and protected fields, and typed CRUD helpers. Install with `pip install flask-modelkit`; import from `flask_modelkit`.

## Docs

- [Agent instructions](https://anoziechibuike.github.io/FlaskModelKit/AGENT.md): the rules an AI coding agent must follow when writing code with flask-modelkit. Read this first.
- [Documentation](https://anoziechibuike.github.io/FlaskModelKit/): guides, project examples and the full API reference.
